crossRefs.note: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are…
For this they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by…
for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.
Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

translations.web: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
translations.bsb: But they do not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
translations.kjv: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.
translations.asv: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; That her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
